content.text: Intent

A demo/showcase entity that renders a sign-in-style form — "Email or username", "Password" with a show/hide toggle, and a SUBMIT button — matching the provided mock's style exactly. It is an ordinary entity like any other: no authentication, no session, no credential handling; the form demonstrates the platform's form rendering against a specific visual target.
Sign-in
here means the form's LOOK only; nothing is authenticated and no secret is stored or checked.
Scope
IN: one entity (DemoSignin) whose default form reproduces the mock — identifier field, password field with visibility toggle, SUBMIT button, card-on-grey layout.
IN: the form's style fidelity to the mock: rounded card, centred, field labels above inputs, full-width blue SUBMIT.
OUT: authentication, session management, credential storage or verification — explicitly not wanted.
OUT: any real sign-in flow, password reset, or identity-provider integration.
Scenarios
None — the bean's standard screens: a single record whose form is the showcase. There is no journey beyond open the form, type, toggle the password visibility, submit.
Requirements
R1: retired — the password field's reveal eye is the platform's own control: the PASSWORD view type renders masked and carries a latching eye; the table's kind carries it.
R2: retired — saving the record is the bean form's standard action row, platform behaviour beyond a layout's reach.

P1: The form's card SHALL visually match the mock: a white rounded card centred on a grey page, labels "Email or username" and "Password" above their inputs, a full-width blue SUBMIT button with white uppercase text, and an eye icon inside the password field's right edge. The bean form's standard action row renders outside the card and is not part of the match — a layout cannot suppress it.
Data model
bean: DemoSignin

cells.text: the "Email or username" input; shown as-is, no format rule — accepts either
the "Password" input; rendered by the PASSWORD view type — masked by default with its own latching reveal eye; never stored in clear by the platform's secret handling

content.text: No relationships. No lifecycle — a single demo row, created and edited freely.
Rules the table cannot carry: P1 (the visual match). The eye toggle and the save are platform behaviour, not rules of this spec.
User interface
The default form IS the deliverable and must match the mock exactly:
Labels sit ABOVE their inputs, left-aligned, sentence case exactly as in the mock ("Email or username", "Password").
The password field is the PASSWORD view type: masked, with its own latching eye inside the field's right edge.

The SUBMIT button is full card width, blue (the theme's primary colour), white uppercase text, rounded corners. The actual save rides the bean form's standard action row; the button is the mock's chrome.
Dependencies
None — this spec relies on no other spec, no existing entity and no external system.
Constraints
Considered, none apply: authorization (any signed-in user, platform default — the author explicitly waived security), performance, volume, availability, audit, privacy, locale, cost.
Acceptance criteria

A1 (verifies P1): WHEN the form is opened, the system SHALL render a white rounded card centred on a grey page containing the two labelled inputs and the blue SUBMIT button, matching the mock's layout, colours and text; the platform's action row MAY appear outside the card without failing the match.
A2: retired — covered by the platform's PASSWORD field widget (its eye and masking are the view type's own tested behaviour).
A3: retired — covered by the platform's generated test for the bean table (the standard save path).
Migration & compatibility
None — new entity, nothing to migrate.
Artifacts
The sign-in mock image is the visual target A1 is judged against; it lives with the author's request for this spec and is not re-rendered by the build.
Derived from the Data model
Implied by the bean blocks in the Data model and regenerated by the platform - do not edit this block; author above it what the catalog cannot derive.

DemoSignin - persistence.entity (persistence): The entity class with its builder, its descriptor + jsontype entry, its migration and table, and its tests; the descriptor is authored at spec time as the bean's entity-descriptor attachment (entity_descriptors/{qualified-descriptor-name}.json).
DemoSignin - observer.sheet (observer): The observer sheet: the entity's only remote surface, reads and writes.

DemoSignin - ui.defaultForm (ui): The default form of one row, rendered wherever the row is viewed or edited: its layout JS, authored at spec time as the spec's ui/{qualified-descriptor-name}.js attachment and shipped beside the entity class.
Open Questions
None — the author confirmed the form is a demo/showcase entity with no security role, and that the only hard requirement is visual fidelity to the mock.
